data.long_description:
Provident is proud to present this exceptional brand-new ultra-luxury villa located in the prestigious DAMAC Hills community, a rare opportunity to own a dream home in one of Dubai’s most sought-after addresses.


  This stunning villa is set for handover within one month and offers an elegant blend of space, privacy, and refined living.


  Property Features:


 8 ensuite and Spacious Bedrooms
 Dedicated Driver’s Room & Maid’s Room
 Elegant Show Kitchen + Separate Hidden Kitchen
 Two Expansive Living Areas (Ground Floor & Second Floor)
 G+2 Layout with generous living space
 Large Terraces on Second Floor & Rooftop
 Breathtaking Views of the Lake & Golf Course
 Huge L-shaped Garden , ideal for outdoor living & entertaining
 Mortgage Eligible


  Designed for luxury family living, this villa combines sophisticated architecture with premium finishes, offering both comfort and exclusivity.


  Community Highlights:
  Located in DAMAC Hills, a premium, fully serviced community offering:


 World-class golf course
 Parks, lakes & landscaped greenery
 Schools, retail, and dining options
 Easy access to key areas of Dubai


  This is a rare opportunity to own a one-of-a-kind villa in a prime location where everything you need is within reach.
